Engagement Manager (NYC)

New York City, US

  • Delivery
  • Full-time

Grab your cape, become a SuperHyro!

Hyro, the leading Agentic Care Communications platform, enables health systems to safely automate workflows and conversations across their most valuable platforms, services, and channels-including call centers, websites, SMS, mobile apps, and more. Hyro's customers, which include Baptist Health, Hackensack Meridian Health, Tampa General Hospital, and Inova Health System, benefit from AI agents that are fully HIPAA-compliant, fast to deploy, easy to maintain, and simple to scale-generating better conversations, successful patient outcomes, and revenue-driving insights.

What are we looking for? 

We are seeking a highly skilled, motivated, and relationship-driven Engagement Manager to lead the post-sale lifecycle, deployment, and ongoing success of our AI agents for enterprise healthcare organizations.

In this role, you are the ultimate bridge between client satisfaction and project execution. You will manage ongoing projects end-to-end, serving as the strategic partner for our clients from kickoff through long-term account health. You will work closely with Account Managers and internal technical teams to ensure our solutions scale smoothly and deliver maximum business value. This position will report to the Manager, Engagement Management.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex enterprise implementation projects end-to-end from kickoff to live deployment, taking full accountability for project delivery timelines, milestones, and resource allocation
  • Serve as the primary, daily point of contact for our clients, nurturing deep partnerships with clinical and marketing executive teams to maintain continuous alignment
  • Proactively monitor, track, and own account health scores to ensure ongoing client satisfaction, building mitigation strategies to address unique healthcare environment challenges
  • Partner closely with Account Managers to align on long-term account strategy, identify growth opportunities, and ensure a seamless post-sale journey
  • Oversee ongoing account maintenance, strategically bringing in Solution Architects (SAs), engineering, and technical teams when relevant to handle complex technical enhancements or call and chat functionalities
  • Bridge the gap between technical AI capabilities and business impact, translating Hyro’s features into tangible outcomes that solve the client’s real-world healthcare problems
  • Collaborate with development, product, and sales teams to ensure high-quality project execution and seamless client follow-ups

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as an Engagement Manager, Implementation Consultant, or Client-Facing Project Manager, with a proven track record of managing enterprise delivery projects
  • Strong Relationship and Escalation Management: Exceptional customer relationship skills with the ability to manage scope changes, drive daily touchpoints, and navigate high-stakes executive conversations
  • Strategic and Analytical Mindset: Experience owning account health metrics and collaborating with commercial teams (like AMs) on account strategy
  • Ability to converse intelligently about complex technical solutions and coordinate effectively with Solution Architects and engineers. Strong understanding of project tools (e.g., Jira, Monday.com) is required
  • Experience with SaaS offerings is required. Experience working within a healthtech company or managing health system clients is a significant advantage
  • Elite documentation and organizational skills to manage continuous client follow-ups across multiple accounts simultaneously

This is a hybrid role, with at least three days per week in our NYC office. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

The salary range for this NY-based position is $110K – $135K OTE annually, exempt, and is based on experience, qualifications, and skills. Compensation for candidates outside New York may vary with local cost of labor.

Benefits & Perks

  • Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave
  • Company-wide long weekends every quarter
  • Hybrid, dog-friendly NYC office
  • Work from anywhere for up to 2 weeks per year
  • Medical, dental and vision for you and your family
  • 401(k) with company match
  • MealPal subscription for monthly lunches
  • Home office equipment coverage
